# Remy's Lab

> Dog products tested by an actual Lab.

Remy's Lab is a TikTok-connected dog product testing brand built around Remy, a yellow Labrador. The site helps dog owners find product notes, partner links, discount codes, and practical dog owner guides without a hard sell.

## Pages

- [Remy's Lab home](https://remyslab.com/): Current product links, discount codes, and affiliate disclosure.
- [Lab Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/): Written notes after Remy actually uses a product.
- [Dog Owner Guides](https://remyslab.com/guides/): Practical evergreen answers for common dog owner problems.

## Lab Notes

- [FURemover Pet Hair Broom: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/furemover-pet-hair-broom-review.html): Rubber bristles pull embedded Lab hair out of carpet and work well on hardwood floors too.
- [BLACK+DECKER Pet Hair Roller: Remy's Test Notes](https://remyslab.com/blog/black-decker-pet-hair-roller-review.html): Tested on a black felt couch, regular couch, comforter, and clothes. Great swap for lint rollers.

## Dog Owner Guides

- [How to Get Dog Hair Out of Carpet When Vacuuming Is Not Enough](https://remyslab.com/guides/how-to-get-dog-hair-out-of-carpet.html): Vacuum the carpet first, then use a rubber carpet rake in short overlapping pulls to loosen the dog hair trapped deeper in the fibers. Gather the fur into a pile, remove it, then vacuum one more time. The rake takes more effort, but it can grab hair a regular vacuum leaves behind.
- [How to Remove Dog Hair From a Couch Without Burning Through Lint Rollers](https://remyslab.com/guides/how-to-remove-dog-hair-from-couch.html): Sticky lint roller sheets disappear fast when you have a Lab. Here is the reusable couch-cleaning option that worked better for us.
- [Rubber Broom vs Vacuum for Pet Hair: Which One Actually Works Better?](https://remyslab.com/guides/rubber-broom-vs-vacuum-for-pet-hair.html): A vacuum is faster, but a rubber broom can grab fur still trapped in the rug. Here is when each tool actually makes sense.
